name: Orange Creek Inn
primary_cta: Check availability (BahamaGo), with email-these-dates as the alternative
brand_truth: A small family-run inn at the top of Cat Island where the only thing between your door and the beach is the road, with its own grocery store, laundry and cars.
buyer: Couples, anglers and divers planning a quiet Cat Island week on a phone, from the US (often Florida) or Nassau, comparing the Out Island specials.

direction.archetype: job spec: dates bar as hero
direction.why: Spec: warm, family-run, sunny; the beach and the studio lead; no stationery metaphor.
